notes.title: News from the Enclave
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/04189ac7ab8e59f42bde06eb7eeeedf82696ffb2.png"][/img][/p][p]We're back![/p][p]It was far too hot here in France over the summer, and I personally struggled to keep up with work. Ideally, I would have liked to take a proper break, but that wasn't really possible. Despite this, we tried to regain some strength and made progress on several topics.
[/p][p]Top of the list is the console version of BLACKSHARD![/p][p]We're in talks with a new distribution partner, and we're planning a great marketing campaign to promote the game to a wider audience. I have worked with these people in the past, and I have complete trust in them. We're aiming for PlayStation and Xbox at least. Switch 2 would be ambitious, but I'm not getting ahead of myself. You'll have news soon. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/f653d9d4d02492d33fdb38892540367e4f67303b.png"][/img][/p][p]Next, we're changing the Unreal version for Blackshard, which is a significant endeavour, as you can imagine. We hope this will solve the problem of crashes when loading saves, which is really frustrating. Once again, we will probably need a few volunteers to test the beta version when the time comes. People who are experiencing this problem, of course. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/9c5a88338009e950a55c5b1c715b9c1d2b272d23.png"][/img][/p][p]All of this is progressing a bit slowly because we have another project that we must prioritise. It is sort of BLACKSHARD's 'dream brother' and it actually started much earlier.[/p][p]
I'll tell you more about it soon in a proper announcement.  In the meantime, here's a little enigmatic visual teaser. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/7d57b16d7187103db6a06ac5f272167e89fc2aa9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This project has put the BLACKSHARD DLC on hold for two reasons:[/p][p]
[/p][p]1) We have financial constraints and other commitments to honour, and these are our priority.[/p][p]
[/p][p]2) We intend to use several features from this project to enhance the BLACKSHARD DLC.[/p][p]
[/p][p]3)I can't reveal everything, but... From a narrative point of view, it's actually a lot cooler.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Thank you once again for your support. For those experiencing technical issues, thank you for your patience. We are a small team of happy but broke people who work hard! It's thanks to you that we get to do what we love.[/p][p] [/p][p]
[/p][p]Take care.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/2acc080b631e1e825b6627c92cd022a2fc3909bc.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: KEY REBIND UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/408ad718f49934aae32d3511111667412b99df93.png[/img]
Hi everyone!

Finally some news. First of all, thanks again for all your enthusiasm for the game, all the screenshots you've posted, all the incredible theories and fantastic reviews. It's been a real joy to share this project with you.

On the good news front, today's update includes:

[b]- A rebind menu for joystick and keyboard controls

- An optimisation pass to reduce CPU VRAM saturation

- A few tweaks here and there in the level art to fix some imperfections.[/b]


This last point is a bit behind schedule, and I've still got a few things to do, because we spent a lot of time on this   [b][i]***"#$£§(//***"!!@[/i][/b]  of a crash.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/13116e762d91efdab87e7a88f21ef4a62e8cce1d.png[/img]

That's where it gets complicated. We've done a lot of invisible things to solve the problem, from tweaking, of course, to magic tricks to get through the save loading without crashing. We've tested a lot of solutions that work for some people. Your feedback has helped us more than you can imagine, but the problem seems to persist in certain cases.

We were going to wait a little longer before releasing this patch, but time is passing and we're no longer seeing crashes from the majority of our testers, so we think it's the right time to release this patch and see how effective it is on a large scale.


There's still a lot of uncertainty, I won't deny it. We're still testing, we're still looking, we're still relying on tweaks to reduce the occurrence. We're pretty convinced that Nvidia graphics card drivers, even the latest ones, are interfering with a bunch of processes, as we've found that other games developed with Unreal are suffering from this kind of problem.

The only thing we can do is continue to refine everything on our side, step by step. It's very frustrating and very depressing, I have to admit. But that's the way it is.

We're doing our best and apologize in advance to those who won't see their problems solved by this update, because there will undoubtedly be some. You're not forgotten.

I don't want to get ahead of myself about the next content, but you should know that things are moving  forward! We're trying to be much more careful in the future.

We will talk again very soon.

Until then, take care.


NOTE :

It seems that screens larger than 2560x1440 are very problematic, and at the moment playing with directx11 is the most practical solution, even if it disables the ray tracing software and thus the global illumination that is a big part of the game's beauty. For now, we recommend not exceeding this resolution.

We've just added a launcher that lets you choose to play the game in dx11 or dx12 at launch.

notes.title: News from the Devs
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/1aef1535de35f57a1f2db6b3256515b519ccde57.png[/img]
Hi everyone!


I've been a bit quiet, but that's only because we've been very busy the last few days.

We've finished the key remapping menu, it's been tested a few times and everything works fine now.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/1c9009a046a4b58e7cdb61182d95a958f09a2e62.png[/img]

We haven't released an update yet [b]BECAUSE[/b] we're still working on the Unreal crash and the optimisation that goes with it. We don't want a new content update to cause any problem for more users, as it seems to have been the case previously.

In short, this means that the next update will have to fix the crash so that we can be sure that the technical issue has been resolved once and for all. Then we can focus on the future of Blackshard and the Enclave. There will be more pleasant surprises to come.

As for the rest, the vinyl is well on its way and there will surely be a short pre-orders window from the label Frozen Records, which we will share here! 

We will also announce the release date of the soundtrack on Steam and a digital (at first) artwork/lore book shortly thereafter!

We won't let up, we promise! Thank you again for your incredible feedback, bug reports, kindness and encouragement. To those of you stuck at the Gates of the Labyrinth, thank you for your continued patience. We're almost there.

Until then, take care!

notes.title: HOTFIX 5 : Settings
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!



Thank you for your feedback on the new options menus, for all the new reviews that have been posted in the meantime, and for everyone joining Discord and getting involved. You people are awesome.



[b]Today's update:[/b] 

- FOV reset after using witnesses, loading, interactions: fixed 

- Vsync reset after respawn: fixed 

- Incomplete menu translations after language change if game is not restarted: fixed 

- We added a message about the Unreal crash at startup (for the simplest and most common solution only) 



Ornicar (Discord name) is currently working on the key rebinding menu and some other customization options. 

I am reworking and fixing some small details/weaknesses in the level art that break immersion in remote (or not) locations, as well as making some improvements to the sound loops and another optimization pass. 

And there are surprises in store. Free additional content incoming, because you are all very supportive and that gives us ideas, inspiration and strength.

I won't say more [b]yet[/b], but there will be a little treasure hunt with familiar elements (area?) and some new ones. 


Until then, take care!

notes.title: GRAPHIC SETTINGS & ACCESSIBILITY UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/9ca6d76507ea5b476d472114d29c9f1595510f9a.png[/img]

Hi everyone! 

The big day has come, the full [b]Graphics Settings and Accessibility menus[/b] are finally here! 
Here are some screenshots of what you can use from now on in the game. Thanks for your patience. We hope that more people will be able to access the game and enjoy it in the best conditions possible! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/29bba07d9c02757d9a977d759bb1a92976c66683.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/4cab0e55da0439f2731d5f5a861533233ca01a8a.jpg[/img]

Regarding the Unreal Crash, it's a hard one, investigation still in progress. We are left, for now, with these three interchangeable and/or complementary solutions: 
• Update the graphics card drivers

• Reinstalling the game seems to be enough and does not lose the savegame (tested and approved in yesterday's stream)

• Try Directx11 / 12, a bit more technical and less comfortable for the game's performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/910441965a4a87236d0940f28f6e6c3dd0d8dfcf.png[/img]

[b]The jump section on pyramidal plateforms[/b] at the edge of the Convergence Zone has been completely reworked! It was too difficult, too poorly lit and deceptive in relation to what I wanted, and frustrated a lot of people. It's fixed! 

The full [b]BLACKSHARD OST[/b] composed by [b]ALT236[/b] and [b]AL9000[/b] is now available everywhere! Spotify, Deezer, Bandcamp etc! You can listen to it, buy it, listen to it again and share it, we are really happy about it and this collaboration has been a blast for us. A vinyl is in the works at Frozen Records, we'll talk about it soon. 

https://alt236.bandcamp.com/album/blackshard

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/43b3a054986ab8c37ab89337f1c6eb745dfecaa5.png[/img]

Next, we're working on a [b]full key rebind menu[/b]. Our dear ultra-tech Dev will be travelling from tomorrow to visit me in France before we head back to his home in Hungary together. I'll be there for a month, in his place in the countryside, so the work and creative emulation will be at their peak! We will complete the purely technical work on BLACKSHARD together, and then it will be time to tell you what we have planned for the future of the game and of the ENCLAVE collective. 

I would like to take this opportunity to wave at the people who have (rightfully) posted negative reviews solely regarding the lack of graphics options, FOV, motion sickness, etc. If this major update addresses your concerns so you can finally play and enjoy the game, please consider supporting us by changing your review! We are fighting the Steam algorithm like all indies, every little gesture is welcome and helps us promote the game and look to the future. 

And for everyone else, that's fine too! A comment with a smiley is already a nice gift <3. We love reading your reviews, they are really groovy, poetic even for some. Thanks, a lot.

We'll also continue to post webcomics on the Enclave website : 

https://encl4ve.tumblr.com/


Until the next news, take care.

notes.title: BLACKSHARD is OUT
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/90e7e77ee0fb972b8af8a3345f65c827a6231275.png[/img]

Hey everyone!


BLACKSHARD is officially out! 
Since we never do anything by the book, we are posting this a few days after the release. 
Time is relative. 

Thanks to all of you who have already ventured into the labyrinth, and for the others: 

Come and see! 

Team news: we are all back, our fellow programmer is alive and well, even if we are trying to make it easy on him and coddle him so that he really recovers from his misadventures. Thanks for all the messages of sympathy, it means a lot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/78844746c7401da6bd2b1ee4ab2045bdb924f6e6.png[/img]

So we start the week with a small update coming this evening: 

- Correction on glitching textures in various levels 
- Addition of a Witness in the lower area of the Tesseract, at the foot of a return path 
- Correction of the teleportation box to the Organon 
- Change in the passage between the Organon and the Crossroads: A state before and after the 'change' + some additions of walkable structures there 
- Various adjustments to decals that were drooling on certain surfaces 
- Fixes to some French translations 

And probably more to be fair, I've got a whole list of small content hotfixes to work on, thanks to the people on Steam and Discord, I'm on it and it's going fast.


Later this week, we're going to add the options to:

- Set the screen resolution
- Set the FOV, completely disable the lag camera
- Customize full graphics quality settings
- Disable motion blur
- Vsync on off 

We're also going to add a message at the start of the game warning that we're using a newer version of the Unreal Engine and that this requires players to have the latest graphics drivers in any case… 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416505/300884aa4f08f3780e344a0c64946ecc9f46ae69.png[/img]

FOR THE CONFIGURATIONS

We have reached this point after active consultation and research with the community: 



MINIMUM CONFIGURATION: 

AMD Ryzen 5 2400G or Intel Core i7-7700K 
Nvidia GTX 1070 or AMD equivalent 
8GB DDR4 RAM low/medium 1080p / 25 to 60fps 

RECOMMENDED CONFIGURATION: 
AMD Ryzen 9 5900X or Intel Core i7-10700K 
Nvidia RTX 3070 or AMD equivalent 
16GB DDR4 RAM high/epic 1080p / 45 to 60fps+ 

We're doing some final checks and tweaking, but this is a baseline for everyone.





Thanks again for your feedback and reviews, we're working on it and will get back to you!
